title: The meat and dairy section
summary: Supermarket Simulator ships the chilled section as a fixture of its own: a base with a collider, two doors and a panel, a wall paint, and cheeses, eggs, milk and ham stocked under named brands.
body: The meat and dairy section is a fixture of its own rather than a shelf with a different label. The base, its collider, a left and a right door and a panel are each named for the section, so what a player places is a display unit built to be walked up to.

It is also painted to match. A wall paint is named for the section, and a level-of-detail piece carries a second spelling of dairy, which is the kind of thing this project reports rather than tidies up on the game's behalf.

The cheese is stocked under named kinds. A Comté, a Gruyère and a Mimolette stand beside a mozzarella, a parmigiano and a parmesan of its own, so the section holds a range rather than one block of cheese.
Eggs are stocked with a bio kind of their own, and the same name is carried on the carton art as well, so the product reads the same on the shelf and on the pack.
Milk is stocked under a named brand. The build carries the brand on the model and on the carton's own picture, which is why a row of milk can be a row of one product rather than several.
The meat side is named as well: a ham of its own and a ham pastry stand beside the cheeses, so the section is not only dairy.

The section carries sheets rather than a plain colour. An albedo, a normal map and a metallic smoothness map are named for it, with a display sheet beside them, and the cheese pieces have sheets of their own. Spilled milk even has a dirt decal of its own, which is why the section can look used.
What this entry does not tell you: what any of these goods costs, how much of it a customer takes, or which of it unlocks at which level. We have not verified those, so we do not print them.

facts.evidence: asset names: SM_Meat&Dairy, SM_Meat&Dairy_Collider, SM_Meat&Dairy_Door_l, SM_Meat&Dairy_Door_r, SM_Meat&Dairy_Panel

facts.claim: A wall paint is named for the section, and a level-of-detail piece carries a second spelling of dairy.
Cheese is stocked under named kinds: a Comté, a Gruyère, a Mimolette, a mozzarella, a parmigiano and a parmesan of its own.
facts.evidence: asset names: SM_Cheese_Comté, SM_Cheese_Gruyere, SM_Cheese_Mimolette, SM_CheeseMozzarella, SM_CheeseParmigiano, SM_Cheese_Parmesan_EROS

facts.claim: Eggs are stocked with a bio kind of their own, named on the model and on the carton art.
Milk is stocked under a named brand, carried on the model and on the carton's own picture.
The meat side is named as well: a ham of its own and a ham pastry beside the cheeses.
The section carries an albedo, a normal map and a metallic smoothness map, with a display sheet beside them.
facts.evidence: asset names: T_Meat&Dairy_Alb, T_Meat&Dairy_N, T_Meat&Dairy_Ms, T_LocalMarket Display_Meat&Dairy

facts.claim: The cheese pieces have sheets of their own, a colour, a normal and a second colour sheet among them.
facts.evidence: asset names: T_Cheese_A_BCA, T_Cheese_A_N, T_Cheese_A_RGBA, T_Cheese_B_BCA, T_Cheese_B_N, T_Cheese_B_RGBA

facts.claim: Spilled milk has a dirt decal of its own.

alt.en: A good the section holds: the game's own parmesan pack, a green Eros wrapper marked Parmigiano Reggiano.
alt.zh: 这一区里的一种商品：游戏自带的帕玛森包装，绿色 Eros 外袋，写着 Parmigiano Reggiano。

alt.en: A second good the section holds: the game's own milk carton, a one-litre Bourlait semi-skimmed.
alt.zh: 这一区里的第二种商品：游戏自带的牛奶盒，一升装 Bourlait 半脱脂牛奶。

alt.en: A third good the section holds: the game's own egg box, an eight-egg bio carton.
alt.zh: 这一区里的第三种商品：游戏自带的蛋盒，八枚装有机鸡蛋。

sources: A local copy of the game, read only. The grounding for each fact is listed on the technical reference pages; nothing here is estimated.
